assessments.nearest_prior_art: SING classifier range/null invariants; CLEAR cross-modal covariance projection; DOLG orthogonal feature fusion; TokenFusion conditional token admission; robust multimodal fusion; CROMA optical-SAR VFM; and the closed V17 MCOF route.
assessments.what_is_not_new: SVD/pseudoinverse, classifier row/null geometry, tangent decomposition, residual clipping, trust regions, multimodal safety, optical-SAR fusion, CROMA, SEN12TS, CE+Lovasz, pretrained initialization and the 24-epoch protocol.
assessments.new_axis: At the fixed final post-fusion segmentation interface, CTSP uses the existing shared classifier only as detached global geometry, preserves the classifier-tangent part of an already formed optical-SAR residual, and caps the normalized class-logit-visible part with a train-only calibrated bound.
assessments.novelty_claim_boundary: Do not claim null-space projection, orthogonal fusion, robust fusion, classifier geometry, optical-SAR fusion or CROMA as new; retain only the narrow bounded residual operation as a hypothesis pending matched seed-0 evidence and controls.
